description: Build script for running rialto unittests, including functions for executing commands, building targets, running tests with optional valgrind and coverage, and generating coverage reports.

methods.name: runcmd
methods.description: Executes a command with subprocess.run, checks return code, and exits on error.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and orchestrate build and test processes.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Builds test executables using cmake and make, with optional coverage.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the test suites with optional valgrind and coverage, handles errors.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs valgrind command arguments with options for xml or log output.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage report using lcov and genhtml, and creates statistics.
